### The Tax Collector and the Pharisee
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-april-7-2022.html
Passage: Luke 18:13
Points:
- God loves sinners deeply rather than being angry with them.
- Religious pride becomes destructive when it hinders others from coming to faith.
- The Pharisee used prayer to boast instead of truly seeking God.
- The tax collector honestly confessed his guilt without offering excuses.
- A simple, heartfelt cry for God's mercy brings complete justification.

### Humility at the Table of Grace
Author: Susie Larson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/humility-at-the-table-of-grace-bible-study-minute-august-6-2018.html
Passage: Luke 18:14
Points:
- Outward prominence and social standing do not signify spiritual maturity.
- Quiet and unpretentious reverence often reflects a heart truly devoted to God.
- Jesus showed that humble sinners find peace with God over boastful leaders.
- Believers must continually depend on God's goodness rather than their own performance.
- True participation in divine grace requires approaching God with genuine humility.
